observations: After the base URL was restored, a live SciForge chat completed a read-only shell diff request successfully.
The completed process rendered a Cursor-like Work replay aggregate with a Diff action row, done state, timestamp, command details, exit badge, file ref, and an expanded Diff detail section.
The expanded detail showed the requested shell command, exit code 1, a workspace-relative file ref, and unified diff hunk markers for the changed file.
The right result pane remained a separate result surface and exposed a process-record count for the completed chat instead of dumping raw stream events.
limitations: This SciForge run does not cover sub-agent transcript/ref expansion.
The evidence stores hunk markers and structural facts only; it does not embed the full raw stream, raw DOM, or complete diff payload.
